note: Adapted from Chhotani's (1997) species-level description of Synhamitermes ceylonicus; the original is in English. Soldier, worker and alate are described, the worker only by its similarity to quadriceps and three measurements; synonymic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Coloration and pilosity as in quadriceps. Total body length 3.2–3.3 mm. Head subquadrate (length with mandibles 1.35–1.37 mm, length without mandibles 0.82–0.91 mm, maximum width 0.78–0.80 mm). Antennae longer than in quadriceps. Outer margin of the mandibles not incurved at the middle; apical half more strongly curved inwards than in quadriceps; shape of the teeth also different. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.31 mm, width 0.49–0.52 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker similar to the worker of quadriceps and difficult to distinguish. Total body length 3.0–3.5 mm, head width 0.76 mm, pronotum width 0.46 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and pronotum dark brown; postclypeus and legs pale; antennae rusty brown; thorax and abdominal tergites paler than the head. Pilosity of head and body moderately dense. Total length with wings about 9.5 mm, without wings 5.0 mm. Head broadly oval (head width including the compound eyes 0.90 mm); Y-shaped suture absent. Compound eyes small, oval, weakly protruding. Ocelli oval, separated from the compound eyes by a distance equal to their short diameter. Fontanelle small, oval, smaller than the ocelli, situated at the middle of the line joining the compound eyes. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shorter and narrower than the following segments. Pronotum as wide as the head without compound eyes (0.67 mm), length greater than half the width; anterior lobe very short, slightly raised, anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin straight. Posterior margins of the meso- and metathoracic tergites deeply concave.
